hypersomnia.doc.mem_7_log.6: If it can hear this: it was not his fault. This box is all I could save. Keep the lights on.

hypersomnia.archive.m_panel.2: Her room here is empty. Read the chalk note in it, then find the same room where she sleeps: the count is on the paper there.
hypersomnia.archive.m_knock.title: 2D at night
hypersomnia.archive.m_knock.0: Since they bricked the door up she stopped knocking. She says she counts in her sleep now, and the marks are on paper, in her room. Not this one.
hypersomnia.archive.m_knock.1: I asked her what the count is for. She says: the door.
hypersomnia.ending.oblivion.line.2: Morning. The room behind you is gone.
hypersomnia.ending.oblivion.line.3: You do not remember the dream. You never do.
hypersomnia.ending.oblivion.line.4: Somewhere below the facility, a small light stays on.
hypersomnia.ending.oblivion.title: Oblivion
hypersomnia.ending.farewell.line.0: You walk to the door. It does not follow.
hypersomnia.ending.farewell.line.2: It says it the way you would. It has always spoken the way you do.
hypersomnia.ending.farewell.line.3: Its eyes are closed. For the first time, it sleeps.
hypersomnia.ending.farewell.line.5: You wake up. You remember her name.
hypersomnia.ending.farewell.title: Farewell
hypersomnia.ending.farewell.hint: Tell it the truth and wake up.
hypersomnia.ending.replacement.line.0: You lie down in the small bed. It is too short for you.
hypersomnia.ending.replacement.line.1: When you close your eyes, it stands up.
hypersomnia.ending.replacement.line.2: sleep. i will be you for a while.
hypersomnia.ending.replacement.line.3: In the morning, someone gets out of your bed.
hypersomnia.ending.replacement.line.4: He walks like you. He answers to your name. He does not sleep.
hypersomnia.ending.replacement.title: Replacement
hypersomnia.ending.unity.line.0: You lie down. It sits on the edge of the bed, the way you used to sit with her.
hypersomnia.ending.unity.line.2: Two halves of one page. The lines meet.
hypersomnia.ending.unity.line.4: You do not hear it lie down. You only notice that the room is warm.
hypersomnia.ending.unity.line.5: For the first time in a long time, you sleep through the night.
hypersomnia.ending.unity.title: Unity
hypersomnia.ending.unity.hint: Tell it the truth and stay.
hypersomnia.ending.eternal_sleep.line.1: She is laughing. On this tape she is always laughing.
hypersomnia.ending.eternal_sleep.line.2: You stop moving. Your hands keep going on their own.
hypersomnia.ending.eternal_sleep.line.3: Years pass on the other side of the glass. The lights go out one floor at a time.
hypersomnia.ending.eternal_sleep.line.4: It takes a syringe from the tray. It looks like yours. The label is a different colour.
hypersomnia.ending.eternal_sleep.line.5: It does not hesitate. Of the two of you, only it is still awake.
hypersomnia.ending.eternal_sleep.title: Eternal Sleep
hypersomnia.ending.nora.line.2: "Can you bring Bunny back? He fell. He's on the floor."
hypersomnia.ending.nora.line.3: Her voice is tired. It is not the voice from the tape.
hypersomnia.ending.nora.line.4: You hold her hand. Something holds yours. It is cold, and it is shaking, and it is yours.
hypersomnia.ending.nora.line.8: You say goodbye. Both of you.
hypersomnia.ending.nora.title: Nora
hypersomnia.ending.subject_48.line.0: You lie down in capsule 47. It is the right size. It always was.
hypersomnia.ending.subject_48.line.1: The needle is cold. The label says: per Director.
hypersomnia.ending.subject_48.line.2: A hand closes around your wrist. It is shaking.
hypersomnia.ending.subject_48.line.4: You press anyway. The hand lets go.
hypersomnia.ending.subject_48.title: Subject 48
hypersomnia.finale.blank: you didn't make it. but you were there.
hypersomnia.finale.confirm.tape: Use again to play the tape.
hypersomnia.finale.confirm.capsule: Use again to lie down in capsule 47.
hypersomnia.advancement.root.title: Session 47
